{{Quote|My Imperial Knights. Jedi Master Vao. We are here to honor the Knights that fell during the treacherous Sith attack on Agamar. We also honor Antares Draco&mdash;fallen on Korriban during the courageous rescue of my daughter and heir, Princess Marasiah. His sacrifice will not be forgotten.|Emperor Roan Fel|<ref name="Legacy—War 1">[[Legacy — War 1|''Legacy — War'' 1]]</ref>}}
A '''remembrance ceremony''' was held on the [[Empire-in-exile]]'s [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] of [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]] early in [[138 ABY]]. Several Knights who had fallen during a [[Operation: Thunderstroke|battle]] with [[One Sith|Sith]] on [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]] were remembered, and Master [[Antares Draco]], who had been [[Mission to Korriban (Second Imperial Civil War)|taken]] by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], was prayed for.
